truths.title: Infrastructure deployed
truths.detail: The bounded AWS foundation exists and is stable.

truths.title: Synthetic controls demonstrated
truths.detail: Individual test evidence has not yet been attached.

truths.title: Real-data pilot authorised
truths.detail: No data owner, source authority, or accountable G3 decision.

controls.name: Workload identity
controls.note: The Lambda role and permissions boundary are deployed. A test record proving credential behaviour is still required before this control can be marked demonstrated.

controls.name: Least-privilege RBAC
controls.minimumEvidence: Role matrix plus allowed and denied access tests
controls.note: Policy configuration has been observed. Positive and negative access tests, with immutable references, are not yet recorded.

controls.name: Private networking
controls.minimumEvidence: Network diagram and ingress/egress policy test
controls.note: Two private subnets and a no-ingress security group are configured. Route and egress test evidence still needs to be captured.

controls.name: Encryption
controls.note: The evidence bucket configuration includes encryption and TLS-only policy. A complete, hashed configuration record remains outstanding.

controls.name: Secret management
controls.note: The baseline intentionally creates no secret. This control requires a separate, approved synthetic-secret test and must not be inferred from the absence of secrets.

controls.name: Central logging
controls.note: A 30-day CloudWatch log group is deployed. Invocation and correlation evidence cannot exist while the function remains disabled.

controls.name: Deployment controls
controls.minimumEvidence: Reviewed change set, pinned inputs, rollback procedure
controls.note: The reviewed change set and successful deployment are known. The complete export and hashed evidence manifest are still being assembled.

controls.name: Backup and restore
controls.minimumEvidence: Successful synthetic restore and measured recovery time
controls.note: No invocation has been authorised. Write, restore, negative real-data rejection, and recovery-time measurement remain outstanding.

pqcPosture.label: Discovery coverage
pqcPosture.note: Fictional assets exercise the evidence model without implying production coverage.

pqcPosture.label: Migration decisions
pqcPosture.note: Deterministic assessments can recommend work; named owners approve decisions.

pqcPosture.label: Execution authority
pqcPosture.note: Issuance, rotation, revocation, deployment, and trust changes are prohibited.

assuranceNote: This dashboard is a presentation of sanitised project state, not an independent audit, certification, production monitoring service, or authorisation to collect data. The repository contracts and retained evidence remain authoritative.
